author: TREY the Explainer
description:
In this video, we will examine the historical possibility that the biblical figure Noah could have met the Sumerian king of Uruk, Gilgamesh.

Featuring art by Duc de Vinny (https://x.com/DucDeVinny)

My Patreon: https://patreon.com/TreytheExplainer?utm_medium=unknown&utm_source=join_link&utm_campaign=creatorshare_creator&utm_content=copyLink

00:00 Introduction 
05:44 The Gilgamesh Question
16:32 The Search for the "Real" Noah  
27:20 Conclusion
